title: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
titleEn: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
titleKu: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun
description:
A stealth-oriented real-time tactics game set in Edo-period Japan. Control a team of five specialists, combine their abilities, and infiltrate heavily guarded castles, camps, and towns.

A new Shogun unifies Japan, but rebellion and conspiracy still threaten the peace. Five specialists are tasked with eliminating targets, gathering intelligence and protecting the realm. Each party member brings unique skills and a distinct personality to the unfolding conflict. The story mixes political tension, stealth suspense and character-driven moments across the campaign.

faq.a: It is a real-time tactics game with a strong stealth focus.

faq.q: Do all characters play the same way?
faq.a: No. Each character has unique tools, routes and tactical uses.

faq.q: Why is it so highly regarded?
faq.a: Its level design, flexibility and stealth problem-solving are major strengths.
